# Clip (clip.foo.ng)

> Free file and text sharing with no account. Short links, optional password encryption in the browser, a real-time shared notepad, and peer-to-peer large file transfer between browsers.

Clip is for developers, students and anyone who needs to move code, text, documents or large files between devices quickly, without signing up.

## What Clip does

### 1. Clip Beam: browser to browser file transfer - https://clip.foo.ng/beam
- Sends files directly from one browser to another over an encrypted WebRTC connection. Nothing is uploaded to or stored on a server.
- Pair with a 6-digit PIN or a link, or pick people nearby on the same network from the radar.
- Send to several receivers at once, keep adding files while connected, receivers accept each file or accept all.
- Chrome and Edge stream received files straight to disk, so multi-gigabyte files work. Firefox and Safari keep the file in memory and handle up to about 2 GB.
- Shows live speed and time left, checks every file with SHA-256, and resumes after a dropped connection (full resume where the browser can save to disk).
- Both people need to keep their tabs open until the transfer finishes.

### 2. Text and file sharing (encrypted pastebin) - https://clip.foo.ng/
- No account. Paste text or drop files and get a short link, with custom slugs, secret edit codes and expiry from 1 hour to permanent.
- Optional password: text and files are encrypted in the browser with AES-256-GCM (PBKDF2 key derivation) before upload, so the server only holds ciphertext. Without a password, shares are stored as plain content.
- Many files on one link, on a custom URL if you like. Files are deleted 2 hours after upload; the link's owner can add or remove files later with the edit code. Use Clip Beam for very large files.
- Preview ZIP contents in the browser, paste screenshots from the clipboard, markdown with syntax highlighting.

### 3. Live Pad (real-time shared notepad) - https://clip.foo.ng/live
- Several devices edit the same pad at once, powered by Cloudflare Durable Objects and operational transformation.
- Scan the Phone Pair QR code to move text and photos between phone and computer.
- Live markdown preview with math and code highlighting.

### 4. Command line
- Plain text: `curl -sL clip.foo.ng/r/<slug>`
- Files: `curl -sL clip.foo.ng/f/<slug>`
- ZIP bundles: `curl -sL clip.foo.ng/z/<slug>`

## How Clip compares

- Versus WeTransfer and similar: no email addresses and no account. Clip Beam has no upload step or size cap from a server, but both people must be online at the same time. WeTransfer-style services keep the file for later.
- Versus Google Drive and Dropbox: nothing to sign in to on either side, so nothing is left on a shared computer.
- Versus Pastebin and Rentry: handles binary files too, adds a live collaborative pad, and can encrypt in the browser.
- Versus PairDrop and Snapdrop: similar nearby browser-to-browser idea, plus shareable links, text sharing, resume and multi-receiver sessions.
